name: Atlas AI Store Builder
summary: Shopify app that builds a full store or product page from a single product link — layout, copy and images generated automatically, plus bundle and cart upsells.
best_for: sellers testing many product ideas quickly who want a full Shopify storefront from a single product link, and who will genuinely stay inside 5 pages and 250 orders a month or have priced the overage
skip_if: you run one established store with real order volume — the caps turn a $39 tool into a variable bill exactly when the store starts working — or you want a page builder you keep after you stop paying
honest_knock: The meter runs on your success, not your usage. $1,000 of bundle revenue and 250 cart orders is a rounding error for a store that is actually working. So the $39 headline describes the bill of a store that has not started selling yet. Price the tier you expect to be on in month three, not the one you sign up on. Two other things worth knowing before you install. The rating is 4.7 from 389 reviews, but 17 of those are one star and the recent ones are about billing rather than the product: one seller writes “cancelled it, uninstalled it, but still getting charged” after two months. And the listing carries a line Shopify does not require of most apps: “Atlas must not be used to copy, duplicate, or reproduce products, product listings, images, or store content from any website, or marketplace without the explicit permission of the rights holder”. That tells you what a paste-a-product-link builder gets used for.

pricing.entry_price_terms: All-in-one · per month, plus usage charges that scale with the revenue your store…
pricing.notes: (prices read 2026-08-18 on apps.shopify.com/dropshipt and helloatlas.io) The listing says “Free to install”, but that is the development-store tier. A real store runs on the All-in-One plan at $39 a month, billed in USD with a 7-day free trial. Their own partners page says 5 days, so check which you get. What $39 buys is capped rather than unlimited: 5 published pages, $1,000 of bundle revenue, 250 cart orders and 50 AI photos a month. Their pricing page states it plainly: “you’ll be charged the base plan fees and given access to features to a limit, any additional uses for those features can be purchased as shown in the per feature pricing”. The App Store listing adds that “additional charges apply as your store generates revenue and impact”.
